menu_phase_probe.scope: Instrumented isolated Windows Vulkan using hash-verified native payload. Three entry routes, three seconds of play per visit. Short diagnostic.
menu_phase_probe.resource_timing: Measure await completion and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get separately. Wait time includes time spent between frames.
menu_phase_probe.cpu_alignment: Lower and upper main CPU, enclosing process CPU and elapsed sample window in microseconds. Require unambiguous wall-clock alignment.

game_thread_probe.wait_state_scope: Instantaneous scheduler state within the bounded sample. Generic wait labels do not establish a root cause.
